Student Chromebooks: Enterprise Management Ready, Chrome O/S, 1-year warranty, 10-hour battery, 65W charger minimum, enrollment in Google Management. Tier 2 Chromebook: Intel Celeron N100, 14" non-touch, 8GB DDR5, 128GB eMMC. Tier 3 Windows laptop: Intel i5 13th Gen, 13"+, 16GB DDR5, 256GB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 Pro, 3-year warranty, Autopilot required. Tablet: A13, 10.2" Retina, 64GB, iOS 17, 1-year warranty. Staff laptops: i5 (Tier 1) or i7 (Tier 2) 14th Gen, 16GB or 32GB DDR5, 512GB or 1TB SSD, 3-year warranty. Desktops: i5/16GB/512GB and i7/32GB/1TB, 23.8" touch, webcam required, 3-year warranty. Monitors: 24", 1920x1080, USB 3.1 hub (minimum; higher permissible), 3-year warranty. All warranties must be OEM warranties; battery life based on manufacturer specifications.

Bid Summary.value: Dallas Independent School District (Dallas ISD) is seeking Student and Staff Computing Devices under bid JA-207652. Responses are due 2024-07-09 14:00 CST, with electronic submission preferred via the Dallas ISD iSupplier portal or a sealed hard-copy original by mail/FedEx/UPS, and no fax or email submissions. A pre-proposal meeting is set for 2024-06-10 14:00 CST via TEAMS; attendance is highly encouraged but not stated as mandatory. The scope covers Chromebooks, Windows laptops, tablets, staff laptops and desktops, and monitors in quantities of 5,000 to 50,000 each, with minimum specs by tier, OEM warranties, and white glove delivery services including etching, asset tagging, Autopilot for Windows devices and Google Management enrollment for Chromebooks. The term is three years with two optional one-year extensions (five years maximum), and required paperwork includes MWBE forms, a W9, Form 1295, three business references, signed acknowledgments of Addenda 1 and 2, and reseller repair certifications. The contact is Jasmine Alzate (JALZATE@dallasisd.org); bid bond requirements and payment terms were not found.

Student Chromebooks: Enterprise Management Ready, Chrome O/S, 1-year warranty, 10-hour battery, 65W charger minimum, enrollment in Google Management. Tier 2 Chromebook: Intel Celeron N100, 14" non-touch, 8GB DDR5, 128GB eMMC. Tier 3 Windows laptop: Intel i5 13th Gen, 13"+, 16GB DDR5, 256GB NVMe SSD, Windows 11 Pro, 3-year warranty, Autopilot required. Tablet: A13, 10.2" Retina, 64GB, iOS 17, 1-year warranty. Staff laptops: i5 (Tier 1) or i7 (Tier 2) 14th Gen, 16GB or 32GB DDR5, 512GB or 1TB SSD, 3-year warranty. Desktops: i5/16GB/512GB and i7/32GB/1TB, 23.8" touch, webcam required, 3-year warranty. Monitors: 24", 1920x1080, USB 3.1 hub (minimum; higher permissible), 3-year warranty. All warranties must be OEM warranties; battery life based on manufacturer specifications.

addendum_changes.new_value: Yes. All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services (asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, delivery to varied locations). Etching is required only on laptops, and both etching and asset tagging are required. Windows devices require Autopilot; Chromebooks require enrollment in Google Management. Vendors must also describe software installation, asset tagging and etching, device deployment and setup, and asset control reporting. Desktops are not secured; deliveries are scheduled with the Dallas ISD ED TECH department.
